posts.en:
dsh-billing-balance is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Shows DeepSeek API account balance and Volcengine Ark Coding/Agent Plan quota windows (5h/weekly/monthly with reset countdowns) in the settings panel, composer dock, and a draggable floating refresh button.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-c6db0ce6e24b1b66713c.html
